dataset.name: Herrentunnel toll (Lübeck)
dataset.method: Fernstraßenbauprivatfinanzierungsgesetz: the toll of the Herrentunnel Lübeck GmbH & Co. KG, as its Gebührentabelle (valid from 1 March 2025) gives it per passage, by height over the front axle (over 130 cm) and axles: class B (2 axles), C (3), D (4 or more); the cash price, with `etc` the Quick-Box/RFID price. Trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be over 130 cm.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: Herrentunnel: the toll table image, as transcribed in tools/tables/transcribed/de-herrentunnel-2025.json

vehicles.description: Vehicles over 130 cm high at the front axle (here: trucks over 3.5 t), by axles

network.description: The Herrentunnel (B 104/B 75 Lübeck-Travemünde), charged at its toll plaza either way.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
